posts.t:
"For caps (RBD and DBR), do they need to
engulf previous swings? for example engulf previous swing low in RBD and
swing high in DBR.

Also can breaking out of a flag, can it also be considered Caps as well??"

If a cap has engulfed a FL, but has not reached the next one, that cap
is PA, telling us that it will not hold price. LTF trades can be taken
on return to it, but only with extremely clear PA.

"I noticed FTR, CAPS, FL are itself smaller flags in lower timeframes, correct?"

Yes.

"Also flag itself is PAZ.

Basically we can trade Inside PAZ which is those boxes from bigger TFs"

Yes we can. In fact, nearly every trade we take is such.

"And we can trade the break of PAZ(Flag from lower tf) on return to PAZ"

This, I don't understand

posts.t:
Right. To answer a PM I got, which was

"Is there any way to know how far will the retrace will happen after the break of the level?"

No.It can retrace to any set of clean orders in the zone it's traveled through.

Ideally it will travel all the way back for a QM at the MPL, or even
break the H/L for a DM, but it often only retraces a short way, leaving
the clean orders beyond for later.

At each minor level it retraces to, we can take confirmed LTF trades,
taking some profits to cover losses, letting some run to the HTF target,
should this be the depth of the RT

Ifmyante wrote: There's nothing wrong with waiting for PA, however rare it is!

However, with experience, we can use approach PA for touch trades. The BSZ is the easiest of these to master

Even when you catch sometimes a good trade thanks to approach PA (not
easy at all!), then the problem becomes the TG... The good thing with
quasimodo (even if they are an endangered specie!) is that it also gives
you a TG, with approach PA, the TG isn't so easy to find! The only help
is to use symmetry, but it's not easy at all!

I have the probelm with AUDUSD right now, i'm long from the beggining of
yesterdays move, we hit a TG and now price is retracing, but i have
absolutely no idea where it wants to go. If i check HTF i think it wants
a little bit upper but well, i don't really know! We'll see...
posts.fa:
Ifmyante نوشت: هیچ اشکالی ندارد که منتظر PA بمانیم، هر چقدر هم که کمیاب باشد!

ولی با تجربه می‌توانیم از PA نزدیک‌شونده برای ورود با تاچ سطح استفاده کنیم. BSZ ساده‌ترین‌شان برای تسلط پیدا کردن است.

حتی وقتی گاهی به لطف PA نزدیک‌شونده معاملهٔ خوبی می‌گیری (که اصلاً آسان نیست!)، مشکل بعدی TG می‌شود... خوبی کیوام (حتی اگر گونه‌ای در خطر انقراض باشند!) این است که TG هم می‌دهد؛ با PA نزدیک‌شونده، پیدا کردن TG این‌قدر ساده نیست! تنها کمک، استفاده از تقارن است، ولی آن هم اصلاً آسان نیست!

همین حالا با AUDUSD مشکل دارم، از ابتدای حرکت دیروز پوزیشن خرید دارم، به یک TG رسیدیم و حالا قیمت در حال اصلاح است، ولی اصلاً نمی‌دانم کجا می‌خواهد برود. اگر HTF را ببینم فکر می‌کنم کمی بالاتر می‌خواهد، ولی خب، واقعاً نمی‌دانم! ببینیم چه می‌شود...

q.x: There's nothing wrong with waiting for PA, however rare it is! However, with experience, we can use approach PA for touch trades. The BSZ is the easiest of these to master
